beforeMCPExecution.command:
t="$HOME/Library/Application Support/Nunsseop/permission-key"
in=$(cat)
[ -n "$in" ] && [ $(printf %s "$in" | wc -c) -le 262144 ] || exit 1
kh=$(tr -d ' \t\r\n' < "$t" 2>/dev/null | od -An -v -tx1 | tr -d ' \n')
[ ${#kh} -ge 64 ] || exit 1
[ ${#kh} -gt 128 ] && kh=$(tr -d ' \t\r\n' < "$t" | openssl dgst -sha256 -binary | od -An -v -tx1 | tr -d ' \n')
while [ ${#kh} -lt 128 ]; do kh=${kh}00; done
i=; o=; r=$kh
while [ -n "$r" ]; do h=${r%"${r#??}"}; r=${r#??}; v=$((0x$h)); x=$((v ^ 54)); i="$i\\$((x >> 6))$(((x >> 3) & 7))$((x & 7))"; x=$((v ^ 92)); o="$o\\$((x >> 6))$(((x >> 3) & 7))$((x & 7))"; done
H() { openssl dgst -sha256 | sed 's/^.*= //'; }
M() { { printf "$i"; cat; } | openssl dgst -sha256 -binary | { printf "$o"; cat; } | H; }
n=$(dd if=/dev/urandom bs=16 count=1 2>/dev/null | od -An -v -tx1 | tr -d ' \n')
[ ${#n} -eq 32 ] || exit 1
p=$(printf 'nunsseop-permission-request\n%s\n%s' "$n" "$(printf %s "$in" | H)" | M)
s=$$
r=$({ printf %s "$in" | curl -s -m 590 --connect-timeout 1 -X POST http://127.0.0.1:47750/permission -H 'Expect:' -H 'X-Agent: cursor' -H "X-Nonce: $n" -H "X-Proof: $p" --data-binary @- 2>/dev/null &
c=$!
( while kill -0 $s 2>/dev/null; do kill -0 $c 2>/dev/null || exit 0; sleep 1; done; kill $c ) >/dev/null 2>&1 &
wait $c; })
case $r in *\ *) ;; *) exit 1;; esac
m=${r%% *}
d=${r#* }
[ -n "$d" ] && [ "$m" = "$(printf 'nunsseop-permission-response\n%s\n%s' "$n" "$(printf %s "$d" | H)" | M)" ] && printf %s "$d" && exit 0
exit 1

beforeSubmitPrompt.command: in=$(cat); k() { printf '%s' "$in" | plutil -extract "$1" raw -o - - 2>/dev/null | tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9_.-' | cut -c1-64; }; curl -s -m 1 --connect-timeout 1 -X POST http://127.0.0.1:47750/agent -d '' -H @"$HOME/Library/Application Support/Nunsseop/notify-auth" -H "X-Session: $(k conversation_id)" -H "X-Event: UserPromptSubmit" -H "X-Type: " -H "X-App: ${__CFBundleIdentifier:-com.todesktop.230313mzl4w4u92}" -H "X-Herdr: ${HERDR_PANE_ID:+1}" -H "X-Muxy: ${MUXY_SESSION_ID}" -H "X-Cmux: ${CMUX_SURFACE_ID}" -H "X-Mux: ${TMUX:+1}${ZELLIJ:+1}${STY:+1}" -H "X-Wezterm: ${WEZTERM_PANE}" -H "X-Wezterm-Socket: ${WEZTERM_UNIX_SOCKET}" -H "X-Kitty: ${KITTY_WINDOW_ID}" -H "X-Kitty-Socket: ${KITTY_LISTEN_ON}" -H "X-Iterm: ${ITERM_SESSION_ID}" -H "X-Orca: ${ORCA_PANE_KEY}" -H 'X-Agent: cursor' >/dev/null 2>&1; printf '{"continue":true}'; true

sessionStart.command: in=$(cat); k() { printf '%s' "$in" | plutil -extract "$1" raw -o - - 2>/dev/null | tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9_.-' | cut -c1-64; }; curl -s -m 1 --connect-timeout 1 -X POST http://127.0.0.1:47750/agent -d '' -H @"$HOME/Library/Application Support/Nunsseop/notify-auth" -H "X-Session: $(k conversation_id)" -H "X-Event: SessionStart" -H "X-Type: " -H "X-App: ${__CFBundleIdentifier:-com.todesktop.230313mzl4w4u92}" -H "X-Herdr: ${HERDR_PANE_ID:+1}" -H "X-Muxy: ${MUXY_SESSION_ID}" -H "X-Cmux: ${CMUX_SURFACE_ID}" -H "X-Mux: ${TMUX:+1}${ZELLIJ:+1}${STY:+1}" -H "X-Wezterm: ${WEZTERM_PANE}" -H "X-Wezterm-Socket: ${WEZTERM_UNIX_SOCKET}" -H "X-Kitty: ${KITTY_WINDOW_ID}" -H "X-Kitty-Socket: ${KITTY_LISTEN_ON}" -H "X-Iterm: ${ITERM_SESSION_ID}" -H "X-Orca: ${ORCA_PANE_KEY}" -H 'X-Agent: cursor' >/dev/null 2>&1; true

stop.command: in=$(cat); k() { printf '%s' "$in" | plutil -extract "$1" raw -o - - 2>/dev/null | tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9_.-' | cut -c1-64; }; curl -s -m 1 --connect-timeout 1 -X POST http://127.0.0.1:47750/agent -d '' -H @"$HOME/Library/Application Support/Nunsseop/notify-auth" -H "X-Session: $(k conversation_id)" -H "X-Event: $([ "$(k status)" = completed ] && echo Stop || echo Interrupt)" -H "X-Type: " -H "X-App: ${__CFBundleIdentifier:-com.todesktop.230313mzl4w4u92}" -H "X-Herdr: ${HERDR_PANE_ID:+1}" -H "X-Muxy: ${MUXY_SESSION_ID}" -H "X-Cmux: ${CMUX_SURFACE_ID}" -H "X-Mux: ${TMUX:+1}${ZELLIJ:+1}${STY:+1}" -H "X-Wezterm: ${WEZTERM_PANE}" -H "X-Wezterm-Socket: ${WEZTERM_UNIX_SOCKET}" -H "X-Kitty: ${KITTY_WINDOW_ID}" -H "X-Kitty-Socket: ${KITTY_LISTEN_ON}" -H "X-Iterm: ${ITERM_SESSION_ID}" -H "X-Orca: ${ORCA_PANE_KEY}" -H 'X-Agent: cursor' >/dev/null 2>&1; true

in=$(cat); k() { printf '%s' "$in" | plutil -extract "$1" raw -o - - 2>/dev/null | tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9_.-' | cut -c1-64; }; if [ "$(k status)" = completed ]; then curl -s -m 2 -X POST http://127.0.0.1:47750/notify -H @"$HOME/Library/Application Support/Nunsseop/notify-auth" -H 'X-Title: Cursor' -H "X-App: ${__CFBundleIdentifier:-com.todesktop.230313mzl4w4u92}" --data-binary 'Finished' >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; true
